title: Reasoning Consensus: Structural Ensembling of LLM Reasoning via Weighted DAG Aggregation
abstract: arXiv:2607.27783v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) reason in free-form chain-of-thought (CoT) without revealing which steps were well supported and which alternatives were rejected. In high-stakes domains, users then cannot judge if an answer rests on sound reasoning. Majority voting and multi-agent debate improve answers using model agreement, but do not expose agreement on individual steps. Reasoning Consensus (RC) extracts a typed reasoning graph from each CoT, merges equivalent steps across graphs from diverse models, and weights every step by how many chains attest to it. RC reveals this step-wise support and the varied justifications behind each answer. On 7 benchmarks across law, science, medicine, narrative reasoning and logic, RC matches majority voting and debate in accuracy (69.4% vs. 69.0-70.3%). translated_title: 推理共识：基于加权有向无环图聚合的大语言模型推理结构化集成
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）以自由格式的思维链进行推理，但不会揭示哪些步骤得到了充分支持、哪些备选方案被排除在外。在高风险领域，用户无法判断答案是否建立在可靠的推理之上。多数投票和多智能体辩论利用模型间的一致性来改进答案，但无法展示对单个推理步骤的共识。推理共识从每个思维链中提取类型化的推理图，合并来自不同模型的图中等价的步骤，并根据有多少条推理链支持该步骤来为其加权。RC 展示了这种逐步支持情况以及每个答案背后多样化的论证方式。在涵盖法律、科学、医学、叙事推理和逻辑的 7 个基准测试上，RC 的准确率与多数投票和辩论方法相当（69.4% vs. 69.0-70.3%）。LLM 裁判更偏好 RC 中得到最佳支持的推理图，而非同一答案的其他推理图。在一项用户研究中，参与者阅读 RC 推理图的速度快于阅读辩论内容……
tldr: 提出推理共识（RC）方法，通过加权有向无环图聚合将多个大语言模型的思维链进行结构化集成，在准确率与多数投票和辩论相当的同时，还能透明地展示每个推理步骤获得的支持度。
en_tdlr: Reasoning Consensus structurally ensembles LLM chain-of-thought reasoning via weighted DAG aggregation, revealing step-wise support across models while matching the accuracy of majority voting and multi-agent debate.
